claims: C1 the goals of the Model Spec can sometimes conflict
C2 the Model Spec helps navigate such trade-offs by instructing the model to adhere to a clearly defined chain of command

concepts.name: chain_of_command_principle
concepts.gloss: the principle that instructions with higher authority override those with lower authority, designed to maximize steerability and control

concepts.name: model_spec_goal
concepts.gloss: a goal stated in the Model Spec that the model is expected to pursue
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'these goals' of the Model Spec, so a class of Model Spec goals is presupposed

concepts.name: goal_conflict
concepts.gloss: two Model Spec goals that can conflict with each other in a given situation
concepts.inference: the clause says goals can sometimes conflict, so a relation between two conflicting goals is presupposed

concepts.name: trade_off_navigation
concepts.gloss: the Model Spec's act of navigating a trade-off between conflicting goals by instructing the model to adhere to the chain of command

concepts.name: adheres_to_chain_of_command
concepts.gloss: the model adheres to the clearly defined chain of command when goals conflict

ontology.gloss: the Model Spec navigates the trade-off between conflicting goals G1 and G2 by instructing the model to adhere to the chain of command
ontology.body: model_spec_goal(G1), model_spec_goal(G2), goal_conflict(G1, G2), chain_of_command_principle(P), adheres_to_chain_of_command(P)
